conclusion_or_finding: Baseline governance maturity was 2.5 out of 5; risk governance scored lowest (1).
High-risk technology was approved without Committee review because no delegation of authority existed.
9 of 18 risks were outside appetite at the Q3 baseline.
Every Committee decision has an owner, a deadline and, when closed, closure evidence.
Two High compliance findings were closed after the Committee's decisions.
Governance maturity rose to 3.0 after one quarter.
